lines.zh: 我这副身量，一走就地动。
lines.en: A body this size makes the ground shake as I walk.

lines.zh: 四腿撑起一座山，往前挪。
lines.en: Four legs carry a mountain forward.
Neck low, I sweep past the treetops.
Every step of mine leaves a pit.
The herd follows where I walk.
My shoulders top the trees, so I walk around them.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩出去，风都变了向。
lines.en: My tail swings and the wind changes direction.
I don't run. I don't need to.

lines.zh: 骨头里像装着一整片林子。
lines.en: It feels like a whole forest hangs in my bones.
The front foot lands firm before the back one lifts.

lines.zh: 草被我踩平，又慢慢立起。
lines.en: I flatten the grass; it rises slowly behind me.

lines.zh: 我沿着河谷走，那里平坦。
lines.en: I walk the river valley, where it's flat.
The stream splits in two around my legs.

lines.zh: 我不看脚下，没什么能绊我。
lines.en: I don't watch my feet; nothing can trip me.
One stride carries me across your whole field.

lines.zh: 这么大的影子，只有我一个。
lines.en: Only I cast a shadow this large.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一堵会呼吸的墙。
lines.en: I stand like a wall that breathes.
That patch of leaves up high is just right.

lines.zh: 我把脖子垂下，缓了口气。
lines.en: I lower my neck and let out a slow breath.

lines.zh: 同伴在我身边，谁也不敢近。
lines.en: Herd-mates around me; nothing dares come close.
I chew slowly, joint by joint.

lines.zh: 蚂蚁爬上我的腿，我不理。
lines.en: Ants climb my leg; I ignore them.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看远处，什么也没动。
lines.en: I look into the distance. Nothing moves.

lines.zh: 风穿过我的肋骨，像穿林。
lines.en: Wind passes through my ribs like through a wood.

lines.zh: 这具身体老了，可还站得稳。
lines.en: This body is old, but it still stands firm.
I let my tail rest on the ground.
The sky is clouding over. I don't mind.
I make no sound, and the forest grows quieter.

lines.zh: 最小的那头，在我腿边转。
lines.en: The smallest one circles by my legs.
I half-close my eyes and listen.

lines.zh: 你站在我面前，小得像颗石子。
lines.en: You stand before me, small as a pebble.
I lower my head and study you a long while.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，也敢靠近。
lines.en: Something this small dares come near.

lines.zh: 我的鼻孔里呼出的风，吹到你。
lines.en: The wind from my nostrils reaches you.

lines.zh: 一百八十点，整群才敢挡掠食者。
lines.en: A hundred eighty, and the herd holds predators off.
You want to tame me? Stand back first.
I won't eat you. You're too small.

lines.zh: 我在你身上看出一件事：不怕。
lines.en: One thing I see in you: no fear.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在你头顶很远的地方。
lines.en: My eyes are far above your head.

lines.zh: 我们成群走，掠食者不敢来。
lines.en: We walk in herds; predators keep away.

lines.zh: 你的脚步震得地响，我认得。
lines.en: Your steps shake the ground — I know them.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，我等你说点什么。
lines.en: You just stand there. I wait for you to speak.

lines.zh: 我的影子把你整个人吞了。
lines.en: My shadow swallows you whole.

lines.zh: 你要留下，就别挡我的路。
lines.en: If you stay, don't block my way.
Your weight is nothing for me to carry.
When I lower my head, you should step back.

lines.zh: 一百八十点命，群里有我。
lines.en: One hundred eighty points, and the herd stands with me.

lines.zh: 谁敢在我腿上留下口子？
lines.en: Who dares leave a gash on my leg?
My hide is thick, but the pain is real.
That shifted me half a step.
Blood hits the ground with a sound.
I turn my head and search slowly.
The pain curls my tail up.
I can't fall. I'm too heavy.
Don't touch that old wound.
This much blood will not draw a predator.
A branch of tender leaves and I'll follow you.

lines.zh: 你举得太低了，我看不见。
lines.en: You're holding it too low; I can't see it.
One bite, and your hand goes with it.
I bend my neck and come closer.

lines.zh: 那叶子上的露水，我看见了。
lines.en: I can see the dew on those leaves.

lines.zh: 你别站着不动，我够不着。
lines.en: Don't just stand there; I can't reach.

lines.zh: 为这一口，我肯低一次头。
lines.en: For that mouthful I'll bow my head once.
I smell sweetness. New shoots.
You step back one; I step forward one.

lines.zh: 这么点，塞不满我的牙缝。
lines.en: That little won't fill a gap in my teeth.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖比你的腰还高
lines.en: My knee stands higher than your waist.
I stop my foot, afraid of crushing you.
After that, you should get clear.
My leg brushes your shoulder.

lines.zh: 地面震了三下，是我在让路。
lines.en: The ground shook three times; that was me giving way.
My tail swept you off your feet.

lines.zh: 我太大了，没办法让得更开。
lines.en: I'm too big to make more room than this.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，你手都麻了吧。
lines.en: Bumping me must have numbed your hands.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，压平了一片草。
lines.en: I turn sideways and flatten a patch of grass.

lines.zh: 我们互相撞了一下，谁也没倒。
lines.en: We bumped, and neither of us fell.

lines.zh: 群里的老伴侣，就在旁边。
lines.en: My old mate of the herd stands beside me.
Side by side, we are two hills.

lines.zh: 我把脖子搭在它的背上。
lines.en: I lay my neck across her back.
In this season even the wind softens.

lines.zh: 我们在沙地上刨出浅坑。
lines.en: We scrape a shallow pit in the sand.
The eggs will lie here, warm.

lines.zh: 整个群会绕着这片地走。
lines.en: The whole herd will walk around this ground.

lines.zh: 它比我矮半头，走得却稳。
lines.en: She's half a head shorter and walks steadier.

lines.zh: 我们谁也没叫，只是站着。
lines.en: Neither of us calls. We simply stand.

lines.zh: 这么巨大的东西，也会轻声。
lines.en: Something this huge can still be gentle.
I curl up a whole branch and swallow it too.
This mouthful will hold me half a day.

lines.zh: 我用舌头把叶子刮下来。
lines.en: I scrape the leaves off with my tongue.
Fruit on the ground is fine by me.
I pull the treetop down and eat at leisure.
I swallow, and my throat bulges once.
That's not enough. I want more.
I keep the young shoots for last.
It falls; I open my mouth and catch it.

lines.zh: 吃完我把嘴在树干上擦。
lines.en: Done. I wipe my mouth on a trunk.
Something is watching us from behind the trees.
I turn my head and it freezes.
A meat-eater, and it came alone.
It has miscounted how many of us there are.

lines.zh: 我的脖子一横，就是一道墙。
lines.en: One sweep of my neck makes a wall.
Every herd-mate has raised its head.
It circles, looking for one on its own.
Even something my size, it dares try.
I lower my neck and get a clear look at it.
That one step tells it everything.
I don't roar. Roaring wastes strength.

lines.zh: 我们一群站在一起，谁都不敢挑。
lines.en: Standing as a herd, no one dares choose us.

lines.zh: 它要是再来，群就一起上。
lines.en: If it comes again, the herd moves as one.
I take the frontmost place.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，把它对着我。
lines.en: I turn slowly until it faces me.
It circles left, and I lean left.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴横在它退路上
lines.en: My tail lies across its retreat.
It's trying to slip between my legs.
I set a foot down and it backs off.
My tail sweeps over its head.
One step of mine matches three of its own.

lines.zh: 同伴已经绕到它身后了。
lines.en: My herd has circled behind it.
I chew leaves and wait for it to move first.
One stride of mine covers three of its steps.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，做出要撞的样子。
lines.en: I drop my head as if to charge.
It's looking for a way out now.
This ground belongs to us.

lines.zh: 它再靠近，我就不客气了。
lines.en: One more approach and I stop being gentle.
We have it boxed in the middle.
One shoulder-check sends it flying.
My forefoot comes down on its back.
My tail cracks out like a whip.
I lower my head and butt; it rolls over.
It bites my leg and I don't move.
I bring my whole weight down.
That stomp missed, and the ground caved.
My kick throws it a dozen paces.
Blood spatters my toes.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩碎了它脚下的地
lines.en: My foot crushes the ground beneath it.

lines.zh: 它的口鼻慢慢垂下去，不响了。
lines.en: Its muzzle sinks and goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我退开，让群处理剩下的。
lines.en: I step back and let the herd finish it.
When it's done I shake my body.
That one was only a shove.
I rise out of a crack in the earth.
First I stand, then I raise my head.
The Cretaceous wind was drier than this.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气，掀起了土。
lines.en: My first breath lifts the dust.
To me the sky is only what's overhead.
My herd waits for me down the slope.

lines.zh: 我一站起来，林子就矮了。
lines.en: I stand, and the forest shrinks.
The grass under me is crushed to mud.
This land can feed something my size.
The old mud still clings to me.

lines.zh: 远处有鸟惊飞，是我惊的。
lines.en: Birds start up in the distance. I startled them.
I don't need anyone's permission.
Getting up took me a long while.
The shadow spreads first; then comes the body.

lines.zh: 我一步，就跨过了你的房子。
lines.en: One step carries me over your house.

lines.zh: 这片林子从此有了主人。
lines.en: This forest has a master now.

lines.zh: 我呼出一口气，尘土翻滚。
lines.en: I breathe out and the dust rolls.

lines.zh: 古老的重量，压在这片地上。
lines.en: Ancient weight settles on this ground.

lines.zh: 火在我背上烧，皮裂开了。
lines.en: Fire burns on my back and my hide splits.

lines.zh: 落地时我的腿弯了一下
lines.en: My legs buckle as I hit the ground.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的头顶，我拼命抬颈。
lines.en: Water closes over my head and I strain my neck up.

lines.zh: 炸响在腿边，我晃了一下。
lines.en: A blast at my legs makes me sway.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我肩上，像根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder like a thorn.

lines.zh: 一道光锁住我的腿，走不动。
lines.en: A band of light locks my legs; I can't walk.

lines.zh: 树顶都秃了，我的肚子在叫。
lines.en: The treetops are bare and my belly growls.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上，我整片皮都在跳。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and my whole hide jumps.
I turn over once in the void.
